notes.title: The Outbound Ghost IS BACK!!! + Sequel Announcement (Free For Steam Owners)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This is Conrad, the lead developer of The Outbound Ghost. Over the past 2 years, this page has been silent because we were in a lawsuit with the game's former publisher (click here to see the details).

Well, I'm happy to announce that The Outbound Ghost's lawsuit is now RESOLVED!

My company Conradical Games (the original developers) are self-publishing the game, and it's now available again on Steam and Nintendo Switch, with the others versions coming out again soon! I've made a video that goes over what you can expect now that The Outbound Ghost is self-published by us, but I'll also have a text version below.

(Also, keep on reading because we also just announced The Outbound Ghost's sequel and it's ENTIRELY FREE to owners of the original game!)

[previewyoutube=is9Qbyj3VpA;full][/previewyoutube]

In short, here's the rundown:

Key News

 The Outbound Ghost is back! It's available right now on Steam and Nintendo Switch
 The performance issues of the Nintendo Switch version have been fixed through a complete in-house re-port of the game by us, Conradical Games.
 All previous owners of The Outbound Ghost's Switch version will get the patch for free through an update on the 18th of October. The Steam update will be released in the coming weeks - we wanted to prioritise Switch because of the porting issues.
 The game will be re-launched on PlayStation at a later date, and will release on Xbox for the first time in 2025.
 The roadmap will be seen through, and some of the updates are already in the Switch version. Will come to Steam in the coming weeks.


The Outbound Ghost Switch Update Changes

 Improved framerate (stable 30fps).
 Improved loading times (~20 seconds per combat -> ~2 seconds per combat).
 German, Spanish, and French localisation.
 A rework of how the in-combat statuses are displayed.
 Completely remastered soundtrack.


The Outbound Ghost: Reborn, The Sequel!
As I mentioned above, not only are we updating The Outbound Ghost, but we're also announcing its sequel. The Outbound Ghost: Reborn!

It's entirely free if you own The Outbound Ghost on Steam, and it's a completely new adventure with a new story, updated combat, new areas, and new figments! Check out the Steam page below (and wishlist it to be notified when it comes out)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884520/The_Outbound_Ghost_Reborn

Why a sequel though?
Well, as we were implementing some of the roadmap additions, we felt that we wanted to take the game even further, but doing so would ruin save files, progression, and more. Because of this, we decided to make a sequel, and make it entirely FREE for Steam owners if you own The Outbound Ghost before The Outbound Ghost: Reborn releases in 2025. This way, it's kind of like an update because Steam owners don't need to pay anything extra, and we are also able to take the concept to the lengths we always wanted to.

You can find the reveal trailer below, and I can't wait to release the game next year!

[previewyoutube=ekYEHvk5sr4;full][/previewyoutube]

Reviews

Before the game entered the lawsuit, it sat around 75% - 80% ratings on Steam, and we felt that this would have easily increased over the additions of our roadmap features.

However, because of the lawsuit, many people review bombed the game in our support, which I really appreciate, but it is now hurting our standing in Steam's algorithm. If you didn't enjoy the game, that's totally fine! But, if you did enjoy the game and want to support us, then leaving a review would help us an immense amount. As well, if you're one of the players that review bombed the game in our support, I would really appreciate it if you changed your review to be reflective of your thoughts on the game, that would help us a lot!

Soul Stalker

When the lawsuit started, I formed a new company called Radhood that focused on self-publishing games, and one of our games is actually set in the same universe as The Outbound Ghost, and it's releasing on the 24th of October! 

It's called Soul Stalker, and it's a bullet heaven roguelike with paper graphics. Think Vampire Survivors and Slay the Spire with Paper Mario-inspired visuals! If that sounds like your kind of thing, then getting the game in the link below would help us so much, and it's discounted for owners of The Outbound Ghost as well through a bundle, so it's a win-win!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

Final Words

Anyways, that's it for this update, and I'm SUPER excited to finally get back to being involved with The Outbound Ghost publicly. I'll be keeping you all up to date as to when the first update will release exactly, but until then, make sure to watch the video I shared above to get the full context and learn about when each of the roadmap features will be added.

See you next time!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

 Added the accessibility option to remove the sound distortion that you get from entering bushes.
 Added the accessibility option to remove the timing gauge on skills.

 Fixed issue where some users experienced "crackling" in menu sound effects.
 Fixed bug that made some users not get [spoiler]Levi as their partner in Ravenside[/spoiler] in chapter 4.

 Re-balanced the two harder difficulty settings to still have the same level of challenge, but with less tediousness. This was done through making the enemies' HP/Stun HP remain the same as the base difficulty, with everything else scaling to be more difficult.
 Balancing tweaks for the boss fight right before you get Trust.

 Added dash tutorialization.

Today's patch is a bit shorter in length, but each individual point makes up for it because the changes and improvements are massive! 

Would also like to say that there's not going to be a patch tomorrow unless it's super critical since it's my girlfriend and I's anniversary so I will be taking the day (mostly) off for the first time in a while!

notes.title: THE BAD BUG IS FIXED!!!
notes.content:
I'm not kidding, this is probably the (2nd) worst bug I've had to deal with in my entire time programming (granted it's only been like 5 years but it was still pretty bad :^| ). To get this fix, download the latest update! You'll know you have it if the main menu version is 1.0.11.

I'm happy to confirm that we have fixed the following:
- Some users experienced a "Chapter 1 lock" where you couldn't progress the story after beating Ernest's boss. This is now FIXED!

- Some users experienced issues with the game crashing on startup when the Unity logo shows. This is now FIXED!

- Some users experienced issues with bosses where if you lost to them and went to another battle, wining that battle counted as beating the boss. This is now FIXED!

- Some users experienced issues with the randomization settings where some bosses that shouldn't progress the story, did so. This is now FIXED!

As you can see, lot's of fixing went on in these past few hours :))). If there are any other bugs that you all have found, feel free to put them here in the comments, tell me on the Discord server, or tell us on the Steam community pinned post!

It's been a blast to see everyone playing and enjoying the game, hearing the feedback, and the general reception! Thank you so much to everyone for supporting the game :)

Also, if you're reading this and don't have the game, then go to the Steam page to get it because it's out now!!!

notes.title: Demo Patch Version 1.04
notes.content:
- Fixed the difficulty and special settings buttons in the title menu not being affected by the UI audio slider.
- Fixed some sound effects in the battles that weren't affected by the SFX audio slider.
- Increased the power of Field Heal by 67%.
- Fixed a typo in the skill description of Lifesteal.
- Fixed the skill description of meteor that said it dealt medium damage, when it dealt high damage.
- Sped up the timing gauge for the meteor skill.
- Fixed a typo in the skill description of Triple Lifesteal.
- Fixed out of bounds locations in Eris' Forest.
- Fixed out of bounds locations in Strand Beach.
- Fixed out of bounds locations in the Southern Outskirts.
- Fixed out of bounds locations in the Outbound Trail.
- Fixed bug that caused you to get the same figment twice in a row if you started with a figment that you get regularly in your playthrough and figment randomization is on.
- Fixed bug where music wouldn't play in the battle scene if you spammed the restart button after losing.
- Fixed bug where the map menu would stay on screen even when it wasn't opened if you declined using quick travel.
- Fixed camera bug in the combat scene where sometimes the camera would tend too far towards the enemies, obstructing the action menu.
- Fixed bug in the first boss where sometimes it would try to use a skill, but it would never come out and you were forced to restart the game.
- Fixed bug in the cutscene before entering Adrian's house where sometimes Michael would phase through the floor and end up very far down, making his dialogue impossible to read.
- Changed SFX for confirming the enemy selecting in the battle scene.
- Fixed bug where resetting or applying the graphics settings would reset the difficulty settings.

notes.title: Demo Patch Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's the third day that the demo's available, and I'm glad to announce that I've barely gotten any new bug reports today, so we're nearing the singularity ;) Anyways, today's patch has quite a few balancing changes, and some bug fixes as well! Very importantly as well, I managed to get the game's file size to 4GB down from 10GB! You won't believe how this happened...

Fixes
- Callousness now gets Minor Limit Break at level 9 instead of at level 11.
- Callousness now gets Minor HP Share at level 11 instead of level 13.
- Callousness now gets Fair Defense at level 13 instead of level 17.
- Callousness now gets Guard at level 17 instead of level 20.
- Callousness now gets Fair Limit Break at level 21 instead of at level 25.
- Comradery now gets Minor Power at level 4 instead of at level 5.
- Comradery now gets Lesser Revive at level 5 instead of at level 6.
- Comradery now gets SP Defense Levarage at level 6.
- Comradery now gets Minor SP share at level 7 instead of at level 9.
- Comradery now gets Minor Replenish at level 8 instead of at level 12.
- Comradery now gets SP Steal at level 11 instead of at level 17.
- Comradery now gets Field Heal at level 14 instead of at level 22.
- Comradery now gets Fair Heal at level 17 instead of at level 27.
- Comradery now gets Fair Revive at level 20 instead of at level 31.
- Regret now gets Poison Poke at level 6.
- Regret now gets Magic Strikes at level 5 instead of at level 6.
- Minor SP Share now shares 7 SP instead of 5 SP.
- Changed point where you get Comradery from the third conversation with Mary and Michael to the second.
- Fixed bug where sometimes the textbox in Michael's first line in the fourth cutscene would be out of view of the camera.
- Adjusted Minor Limit Break such that it gives you an AP benefit even if you use it with 1 AP, whereas before it was only useful with 2 AP.
- Adjusted Major Limit Break such that it gives you an AP benefit even if you use it with 1 AP, whereas before it was only useful with 2 AP.
- Fixed out of bounds situations in Eris' Forest.
- Fixed out of bounds situations in Strand Beach.
- Added extra dig spots next to shovels in Strand Beach to make it clearer how the shovel is used.
- Got the game's filesize down to 4GB from 10GB (it was literally a checkbox to enable compression, I could've sworn that this was already on but I guess not 🙃).
- Added demo version counter in the title screen.

Hope you enjoy your newly squished game file!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Demo Patch Version 1.02
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's been fantastic seeing all of the continued playthrough of the demos, and with all of the bugs that I managed to squash yesterday, the experience is looking super solid ;) Anyways, I've made some more changes today, and you can see them below!

Fixes
- Added VFX to Callousness' shelter that makes it clear what it's protecting, and when it is intercepting an attack.
- Lowered the sound of letters popping in in characters' text boxes and in the tutorial. 
- Made it such that the SFX slider affects the sound of letters popping in in characters' text boxes and in the tutorial. 
- Fixed bug where you couldn't finish a cutscene near the end of Eris' Forest if you played with the "Start With All Apparitions" special setting.
- Fixed bug where sometimes when you defeated all enemies, you could still act 1 more time.
- Fixed a bug with Callousness' shelter where it would infinitely protect its target if you used shelter on another target in that same turn.
- Fixed jumping in cutscenes bugging out if your machine's country configuration used "," instead of "." for the decimal separator.

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: New Demo Update, Spinoff Announcement, Friday's Devlog, And Being 223% Funded
notes.content:
Hi everyone! If you're in the game's Discord server you might know that I've recently been working on making controls clearer! The main feedback I've received from players of the demo is that the button prompts being standardized regardless of your input device is very confusing, and I agree. That solution was always meant to be temporary, but I finally got to implementing something more reliable! The screenshot below shows the new HUD that is in the game!

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/505/f12a70ff6968a70420542b9536bb40df_original.PNG?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628093939&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=1a0e94899a003d6261c72057b8a3595b

As you can see on the top left, the HUD includes button prompts for both dashing and your currently selected item. Something I noticed when watching people play the demo is that they knew how to select an item with the item wheel, but they didn't know how to use it or expected the item to be used immediately upon selection. This new addition should make it clearer! Let me know what you guys think of the change!

Speaking of button prompts, at the beginning of the demo you can now select which input type you would like to use.

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/176/0a2a5900521c312d8c97b4771c54f5da_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628092155&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=b32643f511b68156a0992e48d9eaa90a

Once you select it, all prompts in the game will match your choice! Below you can see a before/after screenshot comparing how the prompts were before and how they are now.

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/225/c472ff14150d5f9a446a92b6bf4d5a91_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628092398&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=c56809c7e2e1c16df84c10ab0b297d0d

You can play the demo right now on Steam so if these new quality of life updates interest you, make sure to give it a try!


Those of you who have seen one of my previous updates know that I am working on a little spinoff of The Outbound Ghost, and below's a little screenshot showing how it's progressed since then.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225570/2e0cfe4c019ae756aabf916b464c036d58447cd8.png

If you're not aware, the artstyle is based off of the original prototype version of The Outbound Ghost before it went in a more Paper Mario-like direction! What genre do you think this game pertains to? I'd love to hear your thoughts in the comments! If you want to learn more about it, this Fridays YouTube devlog will cover most of your answers and more! Make sure to catch it! The spinoff will also be free for all Kickstarter backers who pledged for any tier containing a copy of the game!

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/418/365/592473379bb475b337a4b9c3a0dcea3d_original.PNG?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1628093103&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=f94e50ce0b7736e89dd492825598ee01

This cool pixel style won't just be limited to this spinoff though, as I'll also announce in this Fridays devlog a special option in the main game regarding this style that only Kickstarter backers will have! 

Lastly, I'd like to thank you all again! We're 223% funded, which is absolutely insane! I can't wait to continue working on this awesome game, and I hope that you will all like it when it comes out next year!
